_comment: The core's "systems" rules: the switches a game may turn off, each on as the code has it. A place (the
station, the paper, the dealers, the part shops, the mail order, the street, the diner, the paint booth, the
career) is in a game only while a screen of it is in the flow too: the core's flow has none of them, a setting's
flow/*.json brings the ones it has. A mod changes a switch with a .json file of its own in its rules folder,
naming only what it changes (see docs/modding.md, "rules" and "flow"). A career keeps the rules it was
